_comment: OMP MCP descriptor (ADR-0039). MANUAL user-scope fallback ONLY for setups without the OMP marketplace plugin — OMP expands ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} natively in the plugin's own .mcp.json (unlike Codex, ADR-0035), so a plugin install needs NO descriptor. Do NOT install alongside the plugin: OMP auto-imports every harness's MCP declarations and a duplicate skill-search entry launches twice (caveats §22.3). Env block is kept in strict lockstep with .mcp.json (scripts/check_mcp_env_parity.py).
